paginas.corpo_html: Questions about your portrait, your order or a remake? Write to support@brushedpaws.com and we answer within 1 business day. Please include your order number and the pet's name.

Every Brushed Paws item is made to order. Production takes 3 to 5 business days after you approve the preview. Shipping to the United States takes 5 to 9 business days, so most orders arrive in 8 to 14 business days in total. Orders over $59 ship free. You receive a tracking link by email.

Why this window: competing pet gift stores in our research declare 7 to 15 days from order to delivery. We prefer to promise a number we can keep.

You have 60 days to tell us if something is wrong. If the portrait does not look like your pet, we remake it for free. If you still are not happy, we refund the order. Because every item carries a name, we cannot accept returns of a correct product that you simply changed your mind about; we will always remake or refund first.

Why this design: customers in this market complain most about likeness and about being offered a refund when they wanted a remake.

We collect your name, email, shipping address and the photo of your pet only to make and deliver your order. We never sell your data. Photos are deleted from our systems 90 days after delivery. You can ask us to delete your data at any time.

By ordering you confirm you own the photo you upload or have permission to use it. Colors on screen may differ slightly from the printed item. Production and delivery estimates are not guarantees. These terms are governed by the laws of the State of Delaware, United States.

references.prompt:
Create one premium e-commerce PDP image for Brushed Paws. This is image 1 of 7 in the Watercolor Pet Portrait Throw Blanket carousel (scene: "Competitor carousel image 1 of 7").

REFERENCE HIERARCHY
1. Use the attached competitor scene reference only for composition, camera position, crop, visual rhythm, lighting logic, body pose and product-to-frame ratio.
2. Use the separately attached Watercolor Pet Portrait Throw Blanket Product Master photographs as the sole authority for the product itself.
3. If the two references conflict, the Product Master always wins for every physical product detail.

ART DIRECTION
Reproduce the composition, camera framing, crop, lighting direction and mood of the attached competitor reference image (scene: "Competitor carousel image 1 of 7", from Doyobest). Build a premium, confident visual language for Brushed Paws. The image should feel refined and intentional, never juvenile, overly technical or generic-dropship. Use the Brushed Paws palette naturally: #4A5A6A as the primary brand color, #FBF6EF as a clean neutral background, #6E8F6F as a controlled accent (CTAs, highlights), #C9825B only as a small pop of color (never dominating the frame).

PRODUCT FIDELITY
Preserve the exact Watercolor Pet Portrait Throw Blanket silhouette, materials, hardware, seams, colors and proportions shown in the separate Watercolor Pet Portrait Throw Blanket Product Master photographs. Show Send us one photo. We paint it in soft watercolor and print it on a throw they will reach for every evening.. Do not add, remove, enlarge or redesign any functional element. Do not invent pockets, closures, certifications, labels, textures, seams or accessories beyond what the Product Master shows. Maintain plausible scale, gravity, tension, material behavior and contact shadows.

BRAND AND LEGAL CLEANUP
Remove all competitor logos, trademarks, distinctive competitor prints, patches, watermarks and readable brand text from the reference. Do not imitate proprietary artwork, mascots or packaging design. Apply only the approved Brushed Paws identity when a brand mark is genuinely visible and physically plausible. Do not place promotional copy, prices, reviews or unverified technical claims inside the image.

QUALITY CONTROL
